meta.title: VOLLEY.EXE
meta.description: Retro arcade Pong in your browser. Play in one click, invite a friend with a link, win the bracket.

common.networkError: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

footer.rights: VOLLEY.EXE · retro Pong, born as a 42 school project.

landing.tagline: Real-time Pong. Challenge friends, climb the ladder, win the bracket.
landing.localLink: Or play a local game on this keyboard, no account needed

online.title: Online 1v1
online.body: Quick match against a player at your level, with a server that keeps it fair.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.body: Four to eight players, a live bracket and one champion.

friends.title: Friends and chat
friends.body: See who is online, send a message, invite them to a match.

local.title: Local play
local.body: Two players, one keyboard. Pick the speed and the points to win.

landing.welcomeBack: Welcome back, {name}. Ready for a match?

auth.loginSubtitle: Welcome back. Use your username or email.
auth.signupSubtitle: Pick a username other players will see.
auth.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dots and underscores.
auth.acceptTerms: By creating an account you accept the {terms} and the {privacy}.

strength.label: Password strength
strength.0: Too short. Use at least 8 characters.
strength.2: Fair. Add a symbol or a number.

errors.invalidCredentials: That username or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
errors.invalidUsername: Use 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.passwordBreached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.verifyFirst: Verify your email address first. We've just sent you a new link.
errors.captcha: The bot check failed. Try again.
errors.passkeyFailed: Passkey sign-in didn't work. Try again or use your password.
errors.captchaLoad: The bot check couldn't load. Check your connection or ad blocker, then retry.

auth.twoFactorSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.twoFactorWrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Enter the newest code from your app.
auth.twoFactorLocked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.sessionExpiredBody: You were signed out. Log in again to continue where you left off.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account uses {email}, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam); the link works for one hour.
auth.resetSubtitle: You'll be logged out everywhere after this.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth.resetDone: Your password was changed. Log in with the new one.
auth.checkInboxBody: If {email} can be used for a new account, we've sent a link there to confirm it. Open it to finish signing up.
auth.checkInboxHint: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or send it again.
auth.accountCreated: Account created. Log in to play.

lobby.title: LOBBY
lobby.quickMatchBody: Matched with a player near your rating. Every quick match counts for the season.
lobby.privateRoomBody: Play a friend with a room code.
lobby.tournamentBody: Single-elimination bracket for 4, 6 or 8 players. Start early with 3 or more.
lobby.noMatches: No matches yet. Your history appears here after your first game.
lobby.noFriends: No friends yet. Find players on the Friends page.
lobby.loadError: Couldn't load this. The rest of the page still works.

matchmaking.searchingBody: Matching you with a player. Press Esc to cancel.
matchmaking.waitingRoom: Waiting for a friend to join
matchmaking.shareCode: Share this code with your friend:
matchmaking.timeoutBody: Nobody is searching right now. Try again, or invite a friend to a private room.
matchmaking.disconnected: Lost connection to the game server.
matchmaking.alreadyConnected: You're already in a game in another tab. Close it, then try again.
matchmaking.roomNotFound: That room doesn't exist or is full.
matchmaking.readyTimeout: Not everyone was ready in time.

game.controlsBody: Move your paddle up and down.
game.onlineKeepsRunning: Online matches keep running while this menu is open.
game.reconnectOutcome: If they don't return in {s}s, you win the match.
game.forfeitedOnDisconnect: You were disconnected for too long, so the match was forfeited.
game.courtThemeBody: Colours of the Pong court in every game. Saved on this device.

local.title: LOCAL GAME
local.subtitle: Two players on one keyboard.
local.aiSubtitle: Play against the computer. It reacts like a person: not instantly, and not always right.
local.powerUpsHint: Default: off. Hit the ball through an item: + grows your paddle, − shrinks your opponent's, » speeds up the ball.

tournament.title: TOURNAMENT
tournament.needMore: Needs at least {n} players to start.
tournament.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start.
tournament.noChampion: Everyone left. No champion this time.
tournament.seedingNote: Single elimination. Seeding is random when the tournament starts, and byes fill empty seats.
tournament.startHint: Start now, or it starts by itself when all {max} seats are taken.
tournament.eliminatedBody: You're out. Stay to watch the rest of the bracket.
tournament.yourNextMatchTbd: Your next match: opponent to be decided
tournament.waitingReady: Waiting for the players to get ready ({n} of 2).
tournament.readyOrForfeit: Ready up in {s} s or you forfeit this match

profile.blockConfirm: Block {name}? They can't send you requests or messages, and they leave your friends.
profile.notFoundBody: Check the username and try again.
profile.noHistoryBody: Matches show up here once they are played.
profile.friendsPrivateBody: Only {name} can see who they're friends with.
profile.xpRules: XP: 10 per match (party games too), +20 per win, +100 per tournament title, +25 per achievement

friends.title: FRIENDS
friends.searchHint: Type at least 2 characters, or pick a filter to browse players.
friends.noResults: No player matches “{q}”. Usernames are exact, check the spelling.
friends.empty: You haven't added anyone yet. Search for a username above.

chat.title: CHAT
chat.comingSoon: Messages arrive in the next update. You can already invite friends to a match from the lobby.
chat.emptyBody: Start one from a friend's profile or the friends list.
chat.pickBody: Choose someone on the left to read and send messages.
chat.firstMessage: Say hello. This is the start of your conversation.
chat.blockedNotice: You blocked this player. Unblock them to send messages.
chat.inviteSent: You invited them to a game
chat.muted: You can't send messages for a while after several warnings.
chat.slowDown: You're sending messages too fast. Wait a moment.
chat.strikeWarning: Warning: your message broke the chat rules ({category}).
chat.linkNotAllowed: You can only send links to friends.
chat.repeated: You've already sent that message several times.

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
settings.avatarTooLarge: That image is larger than 2 MB.
settings.avatarWrongType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
settings.displayNameHint: Others see this name. Changing it changes your profile link.
settings.emailReadonly: Email can't be changed here yet.
settings.twoFactorBody: Ask for a code from your authenticator app when you log in.
settings.step1: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or copy the key.
settings.backupCodesBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe; they won't be shown again.
settings.crtBody: Scanlines, vignette and static over the screen.
settings.reducedMotionBody: Turn off flicker, pulses and transitions.
settings.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
settings.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.revokeOthersBody: Every other device will be logged out. This device stays logged in.
settings.othersRevoked: Logged out of every other session.
settings.otherDevicesSignedOut: Every other device was signed out.
settings.passkeysBody: Sign in with Face ID, a fingerprint or a security key instead of a password. Passkeys can't be phished.
settings.passkeyReauth: For your safety, sign in again before changing your passkeys.

system.notFoundLine: This ball went out of bounds
system.notFoundBody: The page you asked for doesn't exist. Nothing you did is lost.
system.errorBody: The page hit an error. Your account and matches are safe.

status.title: STATUS
status.subtitle: Live health of VOLLEY.EXE.
status.unreachable: Can't reach the status service. The site may be down for maintenance.

data.exportBody: One JSON file with your profile, sign-in methods, sessions, friends, blocks, matches, party games, tournaments, messages and API keys (names only).
data.deleteBody: Deletes your profile, friends, messages, API keys and sign-in methods. Your past matches stay in your opponents' history as "Deleted player". This can't be undone.
data.deleteConfirm: Everything listed above is deleted immediately and you are logged out.
data.reauth: For your safety, log in again first. Then you have 10 minutes to delete your account.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.subtitle: Ranked by wins, then win rate.
leaderboard.emptyBody: Finish a match to get on the board.
leaderboard.unranked: You're not ranked yet: finish a match to appear here.

shutout.title: Shutout
shutout.body: Win a match scoring 3+ points without conceding one.

watch.title: Watch
watch.subtitle: Live public matches. Private rooms aren't shown.
watch.emptyBody: Matches appear here while they're being played.
watch.notFound: This match isn't live any more, or it's private.

coach.title: Coach
coach.subtitle: Ask about Pong tactics or how the site works. Answers come from an AI model: they can be wrong.
coach.intro: Hi! I can help with tactics, practice ideas and how features work. Try one of these:
coach.suggestAngles: How do I aim my shots?
coach.suggestAi: How do I beat the hard computer?
coach.disabledBody: The coach isn't set up on this server. An admin can turn it on with AI_BASE_URL, AI_MODEL and AI_API_KEY.
coach.errLimit: You've reached this hour's limit. Try again later.
coach.errBusy: The coach is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
coach.errUnavailable: The coach can't be reached right now.
coach.refused: I can't help with that one.
coach.errWarming: The coach is still downloading its model. Try again in a few minutes.

offline.title: OFFLINE
offline.body: You're not connected. Online matches, chat, friends and your profile need the network. A local match on this device works without one.
offline.hint: This page reloads by itself when the connection comes back.

tournamentHistory.noneBody: Tournaments this player takes part in show up here.

party.title: Party
party.lobbyCardBody: Everyone defends one side of a square court. 3 lives each; last one standing wins.
party.searchingBody: A party starts with 4 players, or with 3 after a short wait. Press Esc to cancel.
party.startsIn: Starting with 3 players in {s}s. A 4th can still join.
party.shareCode: Share this code with 2 or 3 friends:
party.readyHint: The party starts when everyone in the room is ready.
party.youreOut: You're out. Keep watching or leave from the menu.
party.reconnectOutcome: The party is paused. A player who doesn't return in time is knocked out.
party.keys: Move with A / D or ← / →. Your side is at the bottom. Esc opens the menu.
party.forfeitHint: You're knocked out and your side becomes a wall. You can keep watching.
party.leaveHint: You go back to the lobby.
party.droppedOut: You were away too long, so you were knocked out of the party.
party.roomNotFound: That party room doesn't exist, is full or has already started.
party.timeoutBody: Not enough players are looking for a party right now. Try again, or create a party room for friends.
party.courtLabel: Party Pong court, your side at the bottom

look.title: Avatar
look.body: Build your pixel avatar and pick a frame and a paddle skin. More options unlock as you level up and earn achievements.
look.errLocked: You haven't unlocked one of those yet.
look.photoNote: You've uploaded a photo, so it's shown instead of your pixel avatar. Remove it under Profile to show this one. Your frame and paddle skin apply either way.

attract.next: Sign up to play real people online, in tournaments and with friends.

invite.title: Join a match
invite.invalidBody: Check the link, or ask your friend for a new one.
invite.shareText: Play Pong with me on VOLLEY.EXE

replay.label: Slow-motion replay of the last point

ranked.leaderboardSubtitle: This season's ranked ladder: quick matches only. Divisions show after 5 placement games.
ranked.emptyBody: Play 5 ranked quick matches to appear on this season's ladder.
ranked.notPlaced: Play 5 ranked quick matches this season to get a division and appear here.

clip.failed: Couldn't record the clip. Try again.
clip.ready: Clip ready to share or download.
clip.interrupted: Recording stopped because the tab was hidden. Keep this tab open and try again.
